messages.subject: Time recording - 12 unposted entries
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom,

Our records show 12 unposted time entries on your timesheet for the week commencing 19 May. Please post or release these by close of business Monday so we can run the month-end bill run.

Thanks,
Accounts
Whitfield Carter LLP
